summary: Preserve scoped request environment in streaming

delivery.outcome: Streaming inherits the request-scoped environment at generation initialization; scoped endpoints and credentials remain bound by the native worker JSON contract.
nonGoals: No worker environment expansion, resolver changes, dependency changes or PyPI upload.

architecture.decision: Reuse request_environment rather than rebuilding process-global policy during stream startup. Keep closed worker JSON and pinned policy checks.
architecture.rollback: Revert the scoped stream environment selection.

commands: Real loopback complete/stream endpoints and synthetic auth header readback under a different global profile
validation.evidence: Both transports use their explicit scope without mutating os.environ.

commands: Conflicting explicit policy rejection, affected tests, governance and protected independent publication
validation.evidence: Policy switching still fails closed and exact-head native CI/review passes.
